\section[der Verkehr]{der Verkehr — traffic}

\label{lesson:GE-C242-verkehr}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the German for a cause, then the German for behaviour.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: der Verkehr}
\textbf{der Verkehr} — \textquotedblleft{}traffic\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{Verkehr} is \emph{ver-} + the verb \textquotedblleft{}to turn\textquotedblright{}, Old High German \emph{kēran} (EtymDB 2.1): turning to and fro, dealings, then traffic.
\end{cousinweb}
